title: fix(workers): mount workspace paths that contain a comma
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: node workers fail to start when their workspace, HOME, or bundle path contains a comma (for example `/home/ana/Projects/acme, inc/api`), because `docker create` rejects the bind mount argument with `invalid field '...' must be a key=value pair`.

## User Impact

User impact: machines whose project paths contain a comma can use `nodeHost.workerRuns.isolation = "container"` again instead of failing at worker admission. Every path that mounts today produces the same arguments as before, byte for byte.

## Why This Change Was Made

`--mount` is not a plain `key=value` flag: the engine parses it with the CSV field grammar, so an unquoted comma inside `source=` ends the field early. The three bind mounts in `createNodeWorkerContainer` interpolated the path verbatim, so a comma in a directory name split one field into two unparsable ones.

The change quotes a whole `key=value` field only when its path holds a comma, doubling interior quotes, which is the form that parser reads. Commas are the only trigger on purpose: every path that triggers quoting already fails on both supported engines today, so no launch that works can change shape. A path with a quote but no comma is left alone, because Docker rejects it and Podman accepts it today; quoting it here would trade one engine's bug for the other's, so that conflict is not settled in this change.

`--workdir` and the `HOME` environment value take the path as a single argument and parse commas fine (checked against the same daemon), so they stay untouched.

## Evidence

Every run below uses the shipped build of this head: `pnpm build cliStartup` from the PR branch, the real `openclaw gateway`, `openclaw node run --session-host`, and the real container worker.

### 1. Engine arguments, unit level

Each row creates a container through the shipped `createNodeWorkerContainer`, compares `docker inspect` mount sources with the requested paths, and removes it.

| workspace path | `origin/main` (`61093f1d32c`) | this change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/tmp/oc377/plain` | mounts | mounts |
| `/tmp/oc377/acme, inc` | `invalid field ' inc/bundle/current' must be a key=value pair` | mounts |
| `/tmp/oc377/a,"b` | `parse error on line 1, column 68: extraneous or missing " in quoted-field` | mounts |
| `/tmp/oc377/a"b` | `parse error on line 1, column 29: bare " in non-quoted-field` | unchanged, still rejected |
| `/tmp/oc377/a=b` | mounts | mounts |
| `/tmp/oc377/trail ` | mounts | mounts |
| `/tmp/oc377/a:b` | mounts | mounts |

### 2. Container-isolated session, real model

A comma-bearing root `/tmp/proof/work,space/demo` is granted as the node's device folder (node-local `workerRuns.folders` consent), then created, dispatched, and turned by a real model (`deepseek-v4-flash`, OpenAI-compatible; the key is an encrypted secret and never printed):

```
[proof] placement active after 1x5s
[proof] sessions.send (turn 1)  {"runId": "comma195304-turn1", "status": "started"}
2026-11-09T07:19:49 [gateway] agent model: real/deepseek-v4-flash (thinking=off, fast=off)
[proof] worker container appeared after 1x2s: 074bdd07ca66
===== docker inspect mounts =====
  .../bundles/88150e7598...            -> (same)  rw=false
  /tmp/proof/work,space/demo           -> /tmp/proof/work,space/demo  rw=true
  .../workspaces/273147ccf1.../2       -> (same)  rw=true
  WORKDIR=/tmp/proof/work,space/demo
===== container argv/env/state =====
  ARGS=[.../bundles/88150e7598.../worker.mjs, --internal-worker-session]  STATE=running exit=0
  HOME_ENV=HOME=.../workspaces/273147ccf1.../2
===== container filesystem workspace =====
  /tmp/proof/work,space/demo
  -rw-r--r-- 1 1001 1001   20 MARKER_COMMA_195304.txt
  MARKER_COMMA_195304
===== workspace marker on host =====
  MARKER_COMMA_195304
===== marker inside container =====
  HOME=.../workspaces/273147ccf1.../2
  MARKER_COMMA_195304
[{"type":"result","turnId":"37dc351b-...","result":{"status":"completed",...}}]
[proof] assistant finalized after 1x3s
[proof] VERDICT pass: real-model session wrote the marker through a container worker mounted from the comma path
```

What this pins: the real model drives the turn; the comma workspace mounts at its own path as `WORKDIR`, the bundle stays read-only, `HOME` is a private worker workspace, and the model's `exec` call writes the marker inside the container and on the host. Restoring the interpolation at `src/node-host/node-worker-container-engine.ts:297-303` makes this run fail at `docker create` (`invalid field ' inc/bundle/current' must be a key=value pair`).

Workflow (the verdict is the exit code, so green means the session worked): https://github.com/shuisadev/openclaw-pr-195304-proof/actions/runs/42578249220
### 3. Regression coverage

Folded into the existing suite in `src/node-host/node-worker-container-engine.test.ts` (no new file): one case with a comma and a quote in the bundle and workspace paths asserts the quoted fields with doubled quotes and the trailing `,readonly`; the neighbouring test keeps pinning the unquoted argv for ordinary paths.

- `origin/main` engine file with this test file: 1 failed | 5 passed (the new case fails on the missing quotes)
- this change: 6 passed
- `src/node-host/node-worker-supervisor.container.test.ts` (supervisor path, shim engine): 15 passed, including the case that pins bundle and workspace mounts for ordinary paths

### Gaps

No Podman binary here, so that engine is reasoned from its `--mount` parsing rather than executed; local `tsgo` needs glibc 2.34 and this host has 2.28, so type checking comes from CI.

The regression test adds 20 net test lines, recorded in `config/test-lines-allocations/node-worker-bind-mount-comma.txt`.

CI reports `over by: 2; net delta: +20`, and those 2 lines come from files this change does not touch; granting 22 is itself rejected (`allocation credit 22 exceeds allowed ceiling growth 20`), so the grant stays at the 20 lines the test adds and the inherited overage stays a base problem.
